description: Figure 8 is a pie chart that visually represents the breakdown of time costs before and after the implementation of efficient deployment methods. The chart is divided into two distinct segments: a larger, light gray segment representing the 60.9 seconds of time cost that is eliminated by efficient deployment, and a smaller, darker gray segment representing the remaining 26.2 seconds of time cost that persists after deployment. Together, these segments sum to the original total time cost of 87.1 seconds. The chart visually emphasizes the dramatic reduction in time cost, with the larger segment illustrating the substantial portion (approximately 69.92%) that is saved through the efficient deployment method. The caption explicitly quantifies this reduction, reinforcing the chart’s message that efficient deployment significantly cuts down on processing time.
